notes: Notes: up to 6, shown two at a time on the screen with “Page 1 of 3”, turning by themselves every 8 seconds (tap the page number to turn now)
Family Admin: the Memos tab is now Notes, showing the notes as they look on the screen, with a box to add one underneath
The Google script now checks GitHub for a newer version itself every few minutes, the same way as the “Update now” button, and the Updates page shows when it last checked and what happened
The screen retries a script update quietly every 3 minutes, instead of asking you to update by hand

Family Admin → Widgets: hidden widgets are listed too, and a “Not in use” section has the settings of every widget that isn’t on a screen. Removing a widget keeps its settings; adding it again brings them back
